Subject: RE: Quick sync on inference deployment for patient-facing workflow

Thanks for the demo earlier — Marcus and I appreciated the clear breakdown on latency and cost tradeoffs. A couple of follow-ups from our security/compliance team: they want to understand which deployment mode you recommend if we must sign a BAA and ensure log/audit retention for 7 years for a portion of traffic. Specific asks: 1) Do you support Private VPC with customer-owned KMS? 2) Can you provide a recent SOC 2 Type II summary and the typical audit package you provide to customers? 3) Example SLA or playbook for incident response for PHI-related incidents?

We're still early in procurement but need to present a recommended path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) to our InfoSec by next Wednesday. Appreciate any examples or short matrix you can share to make the case.

Elena
Director, Compliance
Unified Care Management

Subject: Re: RE: Quick sync on inference deployment for patient-facing workflow

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, Private VPC with customer-managed KMS is supported; we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and an audit evidence bundle; and we have an incident response runbook we can share (PHI playbook included).

I attached a concise hosting-options matrix that maps common controls (BAA eligibility, KMS, audit logs, retention, latency expectations) across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. High-level guidance from today’s call: if 100% of traffic contains PHI and your InfoSec requires customer-owned KMS + 7-year audit retention, Private VPC (or our on-prem package) is the cleanest path. Dedicated can work if you accept vendor-owned KMS with HSM integrations and can accept shorter log retention on-host with log export guarantees. Hosted is only recommended when PHI is tokenized or excluded.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll share SOC2 summary + incident runbook + a draft BAA (attached) by EOD Monday.
- Monica (CC) will scope an estimate for Dedicated vs Private pricing and a timeline for a Private VPC onboarding.
- Can we schedule a short call with your InfoSec next Tues (June 1) to walk through controls? That will help them sign off before procurement issues the PO.

If you want, I can also prepare a one-slide justification you can bring to leadership.

Thanks,
So?jin Lee

Soojin — thanks, the matrix is helpful. A couple clarifying items from procurement/security after a quick read-through:

- On Private VPC: can you confirm whether network egress for model updates is inbound-only from our side, or whether Redwood's control plane will initiate outbound connections to pull artifacts? We prefer the former for air-gapped policy reasons.
- KMS: we require BYOK (customer-owned keys) with rotation policies enforced by our KMS team. Can Redwood accept a policy that key material never leaves our HSM?
- SOC2 bundle: procurement asked for the summary first; if acceptable we will ask for the full evidence bundle under NDA.

If those answers look good, procurement can fast-track the PO to align with our July pilot. We can do Tue Jun 1 at 10am PT to review with InfoSec.

Marcus — appreciate the questions, answers below. Copying Monica and Rishi for any additional detail on pricing/timeline and control-plane behavior.

1) Control-plane connectivity for Private VPC/on-prem: by default our Private VPC offering establishes a customer-initiated peering / TLS tunnel so that model artifacts are pulled on-demand only after you approve the initial sync. For strictly air-gapped scenarios, we offer an on-prem appliance (air-gapped install) where all artifacts are loaded via signed bundles; Redwood operators never initiate outbound connections to customer networks. I’ve noted both options in the attached runbook.

2) BYOK / HSM: yes — we support customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys and we can enforce a policy where key material never leaves your HSM. Our runtime will request cryptographic operations via a KMIP/FIPS-compatible interface. We will include sample KMS integration docs in the packet.

3) SOC2: attached is a SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) and a short checklist of typical evidence items. We can provide the full evidence bundle under NDA and a secured SharePoint link.

Proposed next actions:
- Monica to send a Dedicated vs Private cost/time estimate by EOD June 2.
- I’ll set the June 1, 10am PT call with your InfoSec and include Rishi to answer control-plane/KMS technical questions.
- I’ll also attach a draft BAA with the specific retention clause (7 years) highlighted so your legal team can review.

If that works I’ll schedule the calendar invite now.

Thanks,
